List of changes:

 Game settings are now saved to a file and synchronized with Steam Cloud
 VSync is now enabled by default
 Fixed stretchy textures on rocks
 Added a camera switch - smooth and strictly following the character
 Fixes in some UI elements
 Possible fix for sound missing on some Linux platform editions
